evidence_references.note: Journey still fails at place-order with SecretUnavailable after access returned
No new Key Vault calls after the restore: failures served from memory
A performance change cached failed secret reads

remediation_brief.supported_hypothesis: The secret provider caches a failed read and keeps serving the failure after access is restored, so infrastructure is green while orders fail.
rejected_hypotheses: Role not yet propagated: the identity snapshot shows the role and the vault accepts reads
remediation_brief.required_behavior: A failed secret read must not be cached as final. Retry with bounded backoff and refresh after access returns, without a restart.
acceptance_criteria: A regression test fails on the current code and passes on the candidate
After access is restored, the next order succeeds without restarting the app
The runbook adds a customer-journey check after any access restore
prohibited_changes: Any change to the referee or its assertions
residual_risks: Other secrets read at startup only may behave the same way
